source: PF11 alias table (contracts/ai-proxy.md 6.1). Platform configuration: an alias may move to another provider model without an app release. credits_per_mtok are placeholders until guides/GD7 sets the credit rates: the contract's 5.1 shape, which is the default model's list price at 1 credit = 0.001 USD of provider cost (cache reads at twice cost). provider_usd_per_mtok are the providers' list prices (cache_write = the 5-minute cache write) so the admin can compare credits with cost; confirm at writing time.

truebex-open.note: An open-weight instruct model whose licence allows commercial hosting (Apache-2.0 or MIT), served by an OpenAI-compatible inference server under the served model name truebex-open on gpu-ai workers. Off until GD3 names the GPU class and GD7 the rates; turns fall back to fallback_alias while no server is warm.
